title: Heisenberg's uranium program as decoy for a secret electromagnetic isotope separation program

tellings.quote: And basically the the picture that emerges is this that the pro the uranium enrichment program that um Heisenberg was running was a red herring

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that the Nazi uranium program run by the German physicist Werner Heisenberg in the 1940s was "a red herring". In his account it was a decoy that hid a secret German program to separate uranium isotopes using electromagnetic methods. He draws on the writers Plimpton Hydrick and Farrell and on a book called Critical Mass. If he is right, Germany's real wartime nuclear work was not where historians have looked.
